summary: Tested 4 new features (Telegram notifications, Google Calendar availability, /api/clients + /api/clients/profile, WhatsApp share widget, Perfil 360° page). All 6 backend tests pass, and all UI selectors verified in frontend. APEC profile shows 3 propostas exactly as expected. Cliente Teste Vencida returns non-zero total_invoiced.
critical_code_review_comments: service_orders.py file is ~590 lines — approaching the recommended 700-line split threshold; consider splitting timeclock endpoints into a separate module for maintainability.

send_telegram_notification silently swallows any non-Exception outcome (e.g., a Telegram 400/401 HTTP error is not logged since httpx does not raise for status). Consider calling response.raise_for_status() and logging failure so notification issues are observable.

client_profile.py: regex matching via re.escape(name) will incorrectly match substrings (e.g., name='APEC' would also match 'APECS'). Consider exact match with case-insensitive collation for stricter matching, or anchor the regex.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 public service order 'TEST_Telegram_Client' via POST /api/service-orders to trigger Telegram notification (background task, no errors in backend logs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py — reuse for regression. UI verified via public URL. Telegram is real (no mocks); background_task fires with no visible error in backend logs = success. Google Calendar returns available=true because google_credentials.json is intentionally absent (by design).
